status: ESTIMATED hypotheses; not GB10 results or deployment authorization
baseline: Reviewed current async process-proxy FP8/EXL3 configuration; freeze pins, clocks and sampling

experiments.mechanism: Tune existing TF prompt tiling, grouping/reconstruct and short-lived scratch for SM121; avoid full expert reconstruction
experiments.basis: Illustrative routed bucket 0.9s/1.9s; reducing it 5-15% gives about 2-8% throughput, conditional on trace
experiments.cost: high: GB10 microbench, compile window, numerical qualification
experiments.exactness_risk: medium/high if tile reduction or rounding order changes
experiments.prove: Same 4096-row chunk/context: per-rank TF kernel critical path and DRAM bytes lower; paired cold 32K/150K TTFT improves; logits and memory gates pass

experiments.mechanism: Sweep PIPE/OBI/runflags and CTA-tail scheduling on actual legal-v2a K histogram and routed-row widths
experiments.basis: 5-8% speedup of a 40-60% exposed MoE share; public 225/273 GB/s leaves limited headroom
experiments.cost: high: isolated SM121 build/microbench, then full serve
experiments.exactness_risk: low only if same FP chain, expert ordering and fp32 sum order are preserved
experiments.prove: B1/B4 at 32K/150K: lower MoE critical path, fewer tail idle intervals, unchanged per-row bits and global target gates

experiments.mechanism: Make MAX_BATCH overrideable in a reviewed future launcher change; independently vary chunk budget and priority-aware threshold
experiments.metric: solo prefill throughput; mixed latency may improve more
experiments.basis: Trade repeated suffix/metadata overhead for TF reuse and scratch; no measured local setting comparison
experiments.cost: low code, moderate controlled benchmark time
experiments.exactness_risk: medium numerical partition sensitivity plus fairness/headroom risk
experiments.prove: Actual qlen histogram, paired 2048/4096 (8192 only after headroom gate), B1/B4 cold TTFT plus decoder p95 gaps and foreground admission

experiments.mechanism: First inspect both ranks' thermal/power clock telemetry; coordinator may test airflow and reversible clock cap in its own window
experiments.basis: Donor clock sweep at 2000-2400 MHz claimed 2.2% round improvement and 12% TTFT reduction; existing cap 2150 and unknown actual sustained clocks reduce transferable gain
experiments.cost: low measurement, operational change owned by coordinator
experiments.exactness_risk: low numerical risk; thermal and reliability regressions possible
experiments.prove: Both-rank clocks/temperature/throttle reasons at 1s cadence across long prefill; fixed other settings, no new thermal throttle

experiments.mechanism: Cache immutable SWA/metadata outside current UP1 coverage; remove only trace-proven sync/dispatch gaps; preserve torch-free process proxy
experiments.basis: Donor idle/host only 0.4ms; local submit p50 0.15ms. A new >0.5ms gap would justify work
experiments.exactness_risk: medium: stale metadata, cancellation and proxy-watchdog ordering
experiments.prove: After UP1 0067 baseline, CPU trace reduces uncovered GPU idle >0.5ms without changing rows, acceptance, watchdog or fairness

experiments.mechanism: Fuse sum output with its immediate consumer or reduce host-staging traffic; attention and MoE reductions cannot simply be combined across their dependency
experiments.basis: 80 x 14.4us about 1.15ms donor total; wire-only 0.2-0.7ms. 0.2-0.7ms savings plausible only if exposed
experiments.cost: high C++/CUDA/RDMA integration; target dual-function config is already UP1-owned
experiments.exactness_risk: medium/high rank-order fp32 reduction, graph lifetime and timeout safety
experiments.prove: Count 80 reductions plus gathers; split ready-to-send, transfer, peer-wait, sum durations on both ranks; lower exposed sum/consumer boundary time and identical bits

experiments.mechanism: Audit existing FULL decode coverage first; only address a real eager hole or tail around head/sampler; width must not require an expensive depth host sync
experiments.basis: Pure decode already FULL; donor exact sampling trim estimated only 0.03-0.25%; mixed piecewise graphs claimed zero sustained gain with 446MiB cost
experiments.cost: medium audit; high redesign if dynamic width
experiments.exactness_risk: high if device depth and host qlen diverge; greedy distributions and async parked-stream ordering matter
experiments.prove: Each B1/B4 step has expected cudaGraphLaunch and scheduled/live row counts; quantify every uncovered CUDA launch, metadata wait and graph padding row

experiments.mechanism: After current K5/D2/native measurements, fit actual remote cost and marginal acceptance per position, context and B; change policy only on stable gain
experiments.metric: accepted-token throughput, not steps per second
experiments.basis: Existing adaptive policy already strong; shorter windows can lose more accepted tokens than they save time
experiments.exactness_risk: low target distribution risk with exact verifier, medium contract/RNG/numerical-path risk
experiments.prove: Paired k/depth windows: (1+accepted)/round_ms per workload; compare full task time with same reasoning and sampler

experiments.mechanism: Prototype only if profiles show TP-MoE staging bottleneck: expert ownership with dispatch/combine and retained attention TP
experiments.metric: B4 decode throughput, speculative ceiling only; B1 regression expected possible
experiments.basis: EP does not halve average expert bytes/rank relative to TP2; it changes communication and load balance
experiments.cost: very high: EXL3 bank layout, loader, all-to-all, graphs and numerical path
experiments.exactness_risk: high summation order, uneven expert load and graph state
experiments.prove: Full per-rank expert-byte distribution plus dispatch/combine/straggler tail; B1 and B4 exact outputs/distribution and full memory budget

experiments.mechanism: Keep existing FP8 target records and K1 exact packing; do not promote a lossy lower dtype for speed
experiments.basis: Donor NVFP4 changed logits and reduced accepted drafts; current sparse work makes generic KV-byte savings poor evidence for latency
experiments.prove: Would require target-logit distribution within same-build floor and actual accepted-token/time gain, not just more KV slots
